title: RBI Proposes On-Tap UCB Licenses for Credit Co-ops with ₹10,000 Crore Deposit Base
summary: Establishes a permanent regulatory pathway for large credit cooperative societies to convert into Urban Cooperative Banks (UCBs).

blocks.content: Establishes a permanent regulatory pathway for large credit cooperative societies to convert into Urban Cooperative Banks (UCBs).

items:
📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
Operational Track Record: Minimum 10 years operations required.
Capital Thresholds: Deposit base ≥ ₹10,000 crore, Net worth ≥ ₹300 crore (as of March 31).

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
Initial Eligibility: Restricted to societies registered under Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act 2002.
Prudential Conditions: CRAR ≥ 12%, Net NPA ≤ 3%, individual shareholding cap of 5%.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
